card.name: Small words inside fixed phrases and titles
card.fires_on: Small linking words (for, his, in, on) in the middle of set phrases, idioms or proper names, where a fixed continuation is expected. Seen in general web text, not drug labels.

modes.label: Idioms
modes.description: A pronoun or preposition inside a fixed idiom, just before its closing words.
modes.example: the Moriscos were playing<< for>> time.

modes.label: Organization and case names
modes.description: A linking word inside the name of an organization, program or court case.
modes.example: Parents Involved<< in>> Community Schools v. Seattle School District
